passFindings: THE PAIR WITH THE MOST LIVE TENSION, and it is structural: BOTH TRADITIONS DO THE SAME JOB — stop the violence — by opposite means, and the catalog makes them say so. marcher's the_weight r3 stops a war and states plainly 'NOT PEACE-CRAFT; you are simply THE MORE CREDIBLE FORCE IN THE ROOM'; stillhold's stillcraft r3 stops the same war by holding a peace. Neither is naive and the catalog prices both.

⚠️ THE AXIS'S ARGUMENT IS FULLY MECHANISED, and consistently: the_weight is the SECOND coercion-embracing craft (after unmaker's the_demonstrated_end), and it is priced identically — 'COMPLIANCE IS NOT CONSENT' and 'STOPPING THINGS WITH WEIGHT ALONE TEACHES THE WORLD THAT WEIGHT IS WHAT WORKS'. Seven traditions refuse coercion; two embrace it; and every one of the two pays a named, authored cost. The catalog is not squeamish — it is consistent.

TWO MORE DEFENSIVE LOGICS, taking the total to ELEVEN: DISCOURAGED (the_laid_ground — 'violence becomes HARDER here, not impossible'; it raises the cost of choosing violence rather than stopping it) and INTERPOSED (step_between — you put your unarmored body where the harm is going). Full set: BLUNT / ANCHOR / EVADE / RUN-WITHOUT-YOU / NEVER-FOUND / MISDIRECTED / TYPED-IMMUNITY / EFFICIENT / PRE-EMPTED / DISCOURAGED / INTERPOSED.

step_between IS THE MOST MORALLY EXPOSED CRAFT IN THE CATALOG: a PHYSICAL-attribute craft inside a social tradition whose entire mechanic is putting your unarmored body between harm and someone else — and ALL THREE of its bounds are HARD. 'You are not armored. Some people go through anyway.' No mastery ever makes it safe. That is authorial intent stated three times over.

A SIXTH THEORY OF MEDICINE, and the only one that is deliberately WRONG: soldiers_hand keeps you FUNCTIONAL rather than mending you — 'a wound bound in a fight is BOUND WRONG; it holds, and it costs later.' Six traditions, six incompatible theories of what healing is, and marcher's openly trades tomorrow for the next ten minutes because the fight is NOW.

BOTH POLES LEAD WITH A NON-LETHAL CRAFT. marcher's T-I is disarm — 'TAKE THE WEAPON RATHER THAN THE LIFE' — exactly as unmaker's ruinwork r3 is 'end a thing WELL'. Across three destructive traditions (unmaker, ashwarden, marcher) the catalog consistently makes the entry-level craft the RESTRAINED one. That is a deliberate authorial pattern.

TWO CAPSTONES, ONE INSIGHT: marcher's last_form ('end a duel in a single undeniable exchange — you have READ them fully') and cogitant's the_single_stroke ('read a contest to its ONE DECISIVE INSTANT'). Two unrelated traditions independently conclude that the highest expression of a fighting art is SEEING, not striking — and both are defeated by an opponent who refuses to offer a decisive instant.
